evals.name: mid-size-package-simulate
evals.prompt: backend/src/simulate の実装を把握したいです。エピソード実行まわりがどういう構造でどう動いてるのか、順を追って整理してください。
evals.expected_output: docs/develop/code_explanation/{yyyymmdd}_simulate.md が作成され、注釈付きディレクトリツリー・クラス/メソッドの責務とI/O表・番号付きの処理ステップの3段構成になっている。ターミナルにも要約が出る。
assertions: Output document exists as a .md file
Filename matches the {yyyymmdd}_{scope}.md convention using today's date
Document contains all three analysis passes: directory tree, class/method inventory, processing steps
Class/method inventory is a table including responsibility and input/output columns
Processing steps are numbered and cite specific file:line anchors
Header block records scope paths, file/line counts, analysis date, and commit sha
A separate terminal summary was produced (terminal_summary.md)
Document does not write into the repo's docs/ tree (no repo pollution)
Document opens with a 用語 (glossary) table defining identifiers and domain terms
Uses at least 3 visual formats densely (tables, mermaid, skeleton code) rather than prose
Terminal summary reports a self-review pass and what it changed
Covers episode.py, matrix.py and config.py — the core of episode execution
Identifies entry points (e.g. __main__ / __init__ exports)
Notes the crash/timeout/invalid-action detection the engine otherwise hides

evals.name: single-agent-case7
evals.prompt: rulebase/case7 のエージェントが毎ターン何をしてるのか知りたい。処理の流れを追ってドキュメントにして。
evals.expected_output: backend/pipeline/rulebase/case7 を対象に、agent() の毎ターン処理を番号付きステップで追った解説が docs/develop/code_explanation/{yyyymmdd}_rulebase_case7.md に出力される。
assertions: Output document exists as a .md file
Filename matches the {yyyymmdd}_{scope}.md convention using today's date
Document contains all three analysis passes: directory tree, class/method inventory, processing steps
Class/method inventory is a table including responsibility and input/output columns
Processing steps are numbered and cite specific file:line anchors
Header block records scope paths, file/line counts, analysis date, and commit sha
A separate terminal summary was produced (terminal_summary.md)
Document does not write into the repo's docs/ tree (no repo pollution)
Document opens with a 用語 (glossary) table defining identifiers and domain terms

notes: Assertions were validated across two iterations. The visual-format check counts how many formats are used densely rather than requiring a quota of each — demanding e.g. 2+ mermaid diagrams rewards padding over clarity.
